purpose: Pre-registered state perturbations to exercise the two required-but-missing H12 branches (MacromolecularComplexation network_ge2_fires, ProteinProcessingII transferase_fires) that never occur naturally in the accepted 50-seed catalog-domain oracle trace. A preliminary dry-run execution of the vendored Karr functions against hand-derived candidate values occurred BEFORE this file existed, solely to confirm the intended REGIME (guard passes vs. fails; ub>0 vs ub==0) was reachable -- this is the normal engineering step of picking values that land in the right regime, not outcome-fitting of a prediction. This file was then authored and frozen (git commit ae116bc) as the single, exact, hash-pinned source of truth BEFORE the 50-seed artifact-producing ingest/comparison execution (git commit c7a9563) that this evidence is drawn from; no value was altered after that freeze, and the frozen file's own hash (recorded in both generated artifacts as perturbation_spec_sha256_lf_normalized) makes the harness/state/output chain independently reproducible from this exact spec. Every value is derived from (a) the vendored Karr source's own formulas, (b) static fixture stoichiometry/rate constants, and (c) the REAL per-seed/per-tick pool ranges already observed in the existing accepted natural oracle trace for the same process (data/m1_sources/karr_native/per_process_traces_v2/).
anti_fitting_statement: Values were derived by hand computation from the formulas below and validated once, during the preliminary dry run described above (before this file was frozen), by direct execution of the vendored Karr functions to confirm the intended REGIME (guard passes vs. fails; ub>0 vs ub==0) was reached -- not to tune toward a specific complex count or exact-match outcome. execution_engine.not_matlab_caveat: MATLAB execution in this project is documented BOOTSTRAP-ONLY (scripts/matlab/README.md), requiring a human-driven MATLAB Online session; that pathway was not used here. This is NOT because Karr/WholeCell source is unavailable: the full upstream WholeCell source tree (including the complete Simulation classdef object graph and RandStream.m) IS present locally at E:\opencell-mirrors\WholeCell (a mirror/junction outside this git worktree). The isolated per-process harness approach below was a deliberate tractability choice, not a source-availability workaround: replaying the original extract_per_process_traces_v2.m pattern requires instantiating and fitting a full Simulation object via the KnowledgeBase construction pipeline, which is a heavyweight, long-running MATLAB-only process not reproducible from this sandboxed session in Octave. Both target code paths, however, are isolable without that full object graph (see scripts/octave_h12_perturbation/README.md), so this harness runs the VERBATIM vendored Karr .m logic (function bodies transcribed unmodified from data/karr_vendored_source/*.m) with only the WholeCell RandStream/base-Process classdef scaffolding replaced by minimal harness stubs, documented per-scenario below. The real edu.stanford.covert.util.RandStream.m source (E:\opencell-mirrors\WholeCell\src\+edu\+stanford\+covert\+util\RandStream.m, method stochasticRound, line 236) was read and confirmed to match this harness's stochasticRoundStub.m formula exactly (roundUp = rand < mod(value,1); ceil if roundUp else floor); mnrnd is MATLAB's Statistics Toolbox builtin (not custom WholeCell code), and mnrndStub.m reimplements its documented multinomial-sampling semantics. Where a scenario's RNG-dependent code path IS exercised (MacromolecularComplexation network>=2), the Octave drivers seed via the legacy `rand('seed', k)` API (scripts/octave_h12_perturbation/run_macromol_network2.m) -- this is Octave/MATLAB's backward-compatible legacy seeding syntax, not an assertion that Octave's underlying generator algorithm matches MATLAB's RandStream implementation; no bit-identical RNG claim is made, so evidence from that scenario is DISTRIBUTIONAL/STRUCTURAL (invariant-checked across 50 independent seeds), never claimed as bit-exact H12 evidence. Where a scenario's perturbed values are constructed so that no fractional/RNG-consuming code path is ever reached (ProteinProcessingII Scenario A), the harness stub's specific RNG behavior is provably irrelevant to the outcome, so exact-match H12 evidence IS claimed for that one constructed regime only (see caveats in the generated artifacts).

seeds.meaning: 50 independent RNG realizations (Octave `rand('seed', <id>)`) applied to the SAME pre-registered initial state per scenario -- NOT 50 different initial states. This directly tests whether the scenario's outcome is deterministic (PPII Scenario A: expect all 50 seeds identical) or genuinely stochastic (Macromolecular network_ge2 Monte Carlo: expect seed-to-seed variation, itself part of the evidence).

Both strictly positive -- genuine competition (previously both were exactly 0 in every natural sample).
